title: Late-Change Goodwill Refund — Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery
content:
**Entitlement.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a customer who paid a late-change fee on a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order on which Northgate itself moved a delivery appointment is owed a late-change goodwill refund, booked as one refund of the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00, with reason fee refund.

**Fee refunds on such an order.** For a late-change fee on a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order on which Northgate itself moved a delivery appointment, and only for that fee, the late-change goodwill refund is made as this rule states, whatever tender paid the order; for a large-item delivery fee or a haul-away charge, and for every fee on any other order, a fee is refunded only as stated in the returns rule and the fulfilment and cancellation rule, or in the rule written for that charge.

**Tender.** The amount of the refund is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same amount applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**Invocation — `refund_late_change_fee_56da608d`.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one refund of part or all of a late-change fee charged on the order, credited to the external payment card that paid it and recorded against that late-change fee with the reason fee refund; the net amount paid on the order goes down by the refund, and the customer sees the refund on the order and on the card at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `fee_event_id` | the reference number of the late-change fee charged on that order that is refunded, read from the order's line and fee lookup | identifier |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the amount refunded on the late-change fee | US dollars, a positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text starting with "Refunded" means the refund is booked and gives `refund_event_id`, `order_id`, `fee_event_id`, `refund_amount_usd` and `amount_paid_usd` (the order's net amount paid after the refund), amounts with 2 decimals. A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an amount not above zero or with more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, a reference that is not a late-change fee charged on that order, or an order refused on its tender.
